en.stage1Text1: Good morning, Postbot. We have some parcels that need delivering.
en.stage1Text2: It looks like some of the delivery zone signs along this street have fallen off. Let's put them back where they belong so we know where each parcel needs to go. I'm sure the building owners will leave us a few tips for helping!
en.stage1Text3: Notice how the delivery zones are arranged from 10 to 100. Just like a number line, the numbers get bigger as we move to the right. Each delivery zone is 10 higher than the one before it.
en.stage1Text4: You can move around using WASD or the arrow keys. Let's go and pick up a delivery zone sign, then place it where it belongs. First, let's have a look down the street.
en.stage1Text5: Here's a delivery zone sign. Pick it up using the E key and place it on the correct building.
en.stage1Text6: It looks like delivery zone building 10, already has its sign. Look at the number line at the top of the screen to help you find where this sign belongs. When you think you have found the correct building, press E again to place it.
en.stage1Text7: Not quite. Remember, the delivery zone numbers get bigger as you move to the right along the number line. Try again.
en.stage1Text8: Well done! This delivery zone building now has its sign in place. Let's do the same with the final 6 delivery zones.
en.stage1Text9: Excellent work, Postbot! Every delivery zone building sign is back in place. Now the parcels can finally be delivered.
en.stage1Text10: Each parcel has a delivery number, but it does not show the exact delivery zone. We need to round the number up or down to the nearest 10 to find the correct zone.
en.stage1Text11: This first parcel has the delivery number 11. There is no delivery zone 11 building on this route, so we need to round 11 up or down to the nearest 10 and deliver the parcel to that zone.
en.stage1Text12: When we round to the nearest 10, numbers from 10 to 14 round down to 10. Numbers from 15 to 19 round up to 20. Since 11 is closer to 10 than 20, we deliver this parcel to delivery zone 10
en.stage1Text13: Well done! This parcel belongs in delivery zone 10. The residents will be very happy that their delivery reached the correct zone. You're on your own for the next 2 parcels. Good luck!
en.stage1Text14: Are you sure this parcel belongs in this delivery zone? Ask yourself which multiple of 10 the delivery number is closest to. Have another look and try again.
en.stage1Text16: Fantastic! You delivered the parcel to the correct delivery zone.
en.stage1Text18: Congratulations, Postbot! That's all our parcels delivered. Let's see how much you earned today.
en.stage1Text19: Great work! We have one final task, though. The robot sorting office always rounds wages to the nearest 10 before paying its workers.
en.stage1Text20: Move the slider on the wages number line or type the value into the text box above.
en.stage1Text21: Are you sure? Take another look at the amount in your wages and try again
en.stage1Text22: Excellent job! You've now been paid for today's work. The rest of the day is yours! I'll see you tomorrow for your newspaper route.
